spans.s:
mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Who or what has or holds.
E.
प्र before षा to have, श aff.

n. (-नं)
1 War, battle.
2 Tearing, rending, destroying.
E.
प्र before धा to have, aff. क्यु.

n. (-नं)
1 Nature, the natural state of any thing, or the cause of the material world.
2 The SUPREME

GOD.
3

Intellect, understanding.
4 Chief, principal, (in this sense, it is always neuter and confined to the singular number.)
mn. (-नः-नं)
1 The first companion of a king, his minister, his eunuch or confident, &c. a courtier, a noble.
2 An elephant-driver.
E.
प्र before धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Haughty, arrogant.
E.
प्र before धृष to be proud, क्त aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Proud, arrogant.
E.
प्र before धृष to be proud, क्तवतु aff.

ind.
According to eminence or superiority.
E.
प्रधान, and तसि aff.

f. (-ता)
Excellence, superiority, supremacy.
E.
तल् added to प्रधान; also with त्व, प्रधानत्वं.

m. (-तुः)
Semen virile.
E.
प्रधान principal, and धातु radical part.

m. (-न्त्री)
Prime minister.
E.
प्रधान, and मन्त्रिन् counsellor.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The chief member of the body, the chief person of a state, branch of a science, &c.
E.
प्रधान, and अङ्ग limb.

m. (-त्यः)
Prime minister.
E.
प्रधान, and अमात्य minister.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Warlike, braver.
2 Eminent, illustrious.
E.
प्रधान, and उत्तम best.

m. (-नः)
Air, wind.
E.
प्र violently, घ to shake, aff. ल्युट.

m. (-धिः)
The periphery of a wheel.
E.
प्र principal, धा to have, कि aff.

n. (-लं)
The circumference of a wheel.
E.
प्रधि, and मण्डल a circle.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Heated, burnt.
2 Lighted, inflamed.
3

Afflicted.
4

Excited.
f. (-ता)
1 A woman in trouble or affliction. []
2 The quarter to which the sun is proceeding.
E.
प्र before धूप to heat, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Proud, arrogant.
2 Treated with contumely.
E.
प्र before धृष to be proud, क्त aff.

m. (-सः)
Destruction, loss.
E.
प्र entirely, ध्वंस loss.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Destroying, annihilating.
E.
प्र before ध्वंस to destroy, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Causing to sound.
E.
प्र before ध्वन to sound, causal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-ध्माः-ध्माः-ध्म)
Blowing violently.
E.
प्र before ध्मा to blow, aff. विच्.

mfn. (-क्)
1 Injurious, doing wrong or violence to.
2 Rebellious, refractory.
E.
प्र before द्रुह to seek to hurt, क्विप् aff.

n. (-न्यं)
Supremacy, superiority.
E.
प्रधान chief, ष्यञ् aff.

ind.
Chiefly.
E.
प्रधान्य, and तसि aff.

m. (-तः)
A Brahman who has finished his studies.
E.
प्र, and अधीत read over.

n. (-नं)
Reading, study.
E.
प्र before अधि to read through, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-ध्वः-ध्वा-ध्वं)
1 Distant, remote, long, as a road or journey.
2 Bowed, bent.
3 Binding, confining.
m. (-ध्वः)
A car, a carriage.
E.
प्र before अध्वन् a road, aff. अच्.

ind.
1 In conformity, conformably.
2 Crooked, crookedly, stooping.
E.
प्र and आङ् before ध्वन to sound, aff. डम्.
